Synthetic fixtures generated with h5py 3.16.0, HDF5 2.0.0, NumPy 2.5.4.

Regenerate with `uv run --with h5py generate.py`.
Covers classic and v1.14-compatible layouts, unsupported HDF5 2.0 layout v5,
user blocks, attributes, scalar/null/empty
datasets, multidimensional chunks, gzip/shuffle/Fletcher32/LZF, endian
integers, enums/booleans, compound records, variable-length strings/arrays,
opaque/reference bytes, hard cycles and external/virtual storage refusal.
